instruction: Right now you're in the living area facing the brown colored chair, move towards the chair. Now move towards the curtain which is beside the entrance. Now turn left you can see a black cupboard in front of you, move towards the cupboard. You can see two chairs in front of you, move towards the chairs. Now you can see a way to the kitchen, move towards the entrance of the kitchen, you can see a marble with shelves in the middle of the kitchen, move towards the shelves, now turn right, you can see an entrance and a chair in front of you, move towards the chair, and enter the dinning room. Now turn left, you can see a dinning table with eight chairs around it to your right and a cupboard to your left, move towards the cupboard and stand in front of the cupboard and it will be the end point.
